summary: Post-merge era has proven disappointing for crypto, with ETH experiencing a sell the news event and BTC on its fifth test of critical 19k support. Macro headwinds dominate with hot CPI data and an upcoming FOMC rate hike (expected 75bps). The goldilocks scenario of soft inflation and crypto narratives has evaporated. BTC at range low could bounce short-term if FOMC is in line, but bigger picture risk remains elevated. ETH shows bearish weekly structure with lower highs and lower lows. Broader markets (S&P, NASDAQ) have lost key support levels, suggesting more downside. Recommendations: be patient, defensive, and focus on short-term trading or wait for clearer levels to develop.
